messages:
Diego M.: hey all, Diego here (joined infra). two quick asks: vpn + dockerhub read for builds, and who owns the billing alerts so I know who to ping if CI starts spamming errors?

Amy - People Ops: welcome Diego! for vendor creds + dockerhub request the 'new-hire - infra' flow in Access Portal. include your GitHub handle and intended repos. billing alert ownership is under finance-alerts alias, but dev teams usually have oncall rotations.

Nikhil (SRE): @Diego for VPN make sure your device is enrolled in MDM. For dockerhub read we can grant org-level pull only for 7 days during onboarding. Open Access Portal -> request 'dockerhub-read'. I'll watch the ticket. For billing alerts, ping billing-oncall@redwood.com and cc the repo owners; we keep a billing-owners file in infra/docs.

ops-bot: Ticket ONB-4522 created: dockerhub-read for Diego M. Status: pending.

Diego M.: submitted ONB-4522 and enrolled in MDM. question: if billing alerts fire late-night and I need to escalate, who pages?

Nikhil (SRE): after-hours page infra-oncall for platform-wide billing impacts, billing-oncall for billing infra. if it's quota-related for a specific service page that service's oncall. add the ticket link in the incident channel so billing-sre can correlate.

ops-bot: ONB-4522 updated: dockerhub-read approved. Expiry: 7 days.

Diego M.: confirmed I can pull images now. thanks all :tada:

Amy - People Ops: noted an onboarding checklist update: include billing-oncall alias and the billing-owners doc link.

Diego M.: will add my ssh pubkey to the portal next. thanks everyone!
